_meta.title: AutoHV BiCMOS180 PDK - phase-1 anchor values
_meta.purpose: Golden figures of merit with tolerance bands. Phase 2 measures each and asserts against lo/hi.
_meta.sigma_convention_note: PDK mismatch literals are 3-sigma (HSPICE AGAUSS). Sigma anchors here are 1-SIGMA unless stated.

qualification_temperature_range_proposed.basis: automotive BCD default; the PDK model files state NO range at all (inventory 4.4)

_meta.merge_note: Phase-4 Step-1: merged pass-3 catalog amendments (P3-1..P3-5) and the Step-0 two-regime 200V ladder (0.73 below 40V grounded; ~1.0-1.2 above 40V literature). N 60/80/120/200V ron_times_w = 15/21/32/45 kohm.um; P = N x 2.5->3.0 rising penalty. Added VDMOS va_class and DNMOS20 depletion Idss/Vth anchors. 20-40V rungs and all kp grounded/unchanged.
_meta.expected_pass_now: F1/F2/F3/F4/F6/F7, ladder-B, NMOS12 -- previously expected-fail, now expected to pass their amended bands after the phase-3 fix batch.

_vdmos_kp_conditional.note: kp target depends on an unresolved maintainer decision (audit fix #2).

decision_A_10um_cell.description: W_REF=10u is a genuine drawn 10 um cell - the convention the June-2 cap fix established. RECOMMENDED.

kp_from_idsat_density.basis: kp=2*Id/Vov^2 at Id=(0.05-0.3 mA/um)*10 um, Vov=4 V

decision_A_10um_cell.cross_check: the mu*Cox route and the Idsat-density route differ by ~3x; the drift region rather than the channel limits LDMOS Isat, so prefer the Idsat-density band.

decision_B_power_die.description: W_REF is a label on a much larger multi-cell power device.
decision_B_power_die.consequence: kp/rd/rs stay as-is, but cgs/cgdmax/cjo and the mismatch coefficients must scale UP by the same factor, and the wrapper W_REF=10u comment plus the device_limits.csv W ranges become wrong.
decision_B_power_die.verdict: NOT recommended - it contradicts the cjo and body-diode groups, which independently land on the 10 um cell (audit 1).

beta.basis: forward beta; band is typical process spread

ft_times_bvceo_johnson.basis: Johnson limit E_max*v_sat/(2*pi) ~ 200 GHz.V for silicon; must not exceed

bvceo_implied.basis: BVCBO/beta^(1/n), n=MAV_BJT=4; NOT modelled or documented anywhere (audit 4.1)

is_current_density.basis: requires a DECLARED emitter area for AREA=1, which the PDK does not state (audit 4.3)

cje_density.basis: emitter junction, same declared area as is

flicker_corner.basis: BJT 1/f corner; PDK gives 3.12 MHz and bias-INDEPENDENT because af=1 (audit 4.2). Needs af 1.5-2.0.

_known_artifacts.note: Deliberate model artifacts. Phase 2 must NOT file these as bugs. Each entry gives its magnitude and the measurements it corrupts.

Rcond_gate_leakage.where: all 13 VDMOS subckts: Rcond g_int s 1e6
Rcond_gate_leakage.magnitude: 1.8 uA at Vgs=1.8 V; 5.0 uA at 5 V; 12.0 uA at 12 V
Rcond_gate_leakage.physical_truth: a real MOS gate draws tunnelling current only, below 1 pA/um^2 at tox above 20nm, so the artifact is ~6 orders too large
corrupts: any Iq or standby-current measurement on an HV gate node
Rcond_gate_leakage.why_present: fixes the multi-instance floating-mirror singular matrix (inventory 3, commits 4b05308 / 454959e)

Rgmin_gate_shunt.where: all 13 VDMOS subckts: Rgmin g g_int 1e9
Rgmin_gate_shunt.magnitude: 1.8 nA at 1.8 V, 5.0 nA at 5 V
Rgmin_gate_shunt.physical_truth: same mechanism as Rcond but 1000x smaller; negligible
Rgmin_gate_shunt.why_present: fixes the cascoded-LDMOS singular matrix at MM_ON=0 (commit 0ceabc3)

self_heating_scope.physical_truth: Rds(on) and kp also have strong thermal feedback
self_heating_scope.why_present: documented first-cut limitation in the .inc header

B_pdiss_includes_rdrift.magnitude: Vsense spans dd..dd_sense but power uses V(d,s), which includes the external Rdrift drop
B_pdiss_includes_rdrift.physical_truth: the drift resistor is outside the transistor model, so its dissipation should not drive TJ
corrupts: junction temperature on the 200 V parts, overestimated by the Rdrift share of total dissipation
B_pdiss_includes_rdrift.why_present: artifact of the Rdrift wrapper construction (inventory 6.5 #16)

vdmos_caps_not_corner_parametrized.magnitude: cgs/cgdmax/cgdmin/cjo are fixed across all 5 corners
vdmos_caps_not_corner_parametrized.physical_truth: diode cjo IS corner-parametrized in the same file; VDMOS should be too
corrupts: switching-time corner spread on every VDMOS (identically zero)

nmos12_pmos12_frozen_params.magnitude: tox, cj, cjsw, js are bare constants with no corner or statistical term
nmos12_pmos12_frozen_params.physical_truth: the other six BSIM3 cards corner all four
corrupts: all 12 V dynamic corner spread (identically zero)
internal consistency of the 12 V corner set (FF mobility on TT oxide)

agauss_evaluated_when_mm_sigma_set.magnitude: the AGAUSS draw is still consumed when MM_SIGMA is nonzero, perturbing the RNG sequence
corrupts: reproducibility of an MC sequence run alongside corner sims
agauss_evaluated_when_mm_sigma_set.why_present: ngspice .param has no comparison operators, forcing the additive form (MISMATCH_CORNERS.md 5.5)

mm_on_and_mm_sigma_add.magnitude: the random and deterministic terms SUM
corrupts: any run with MM_ON=1 and MM_SIGMA nonzero simultaneously - explicitly do-not-do-this

_open_maintainer_decisions.vdmos_scale: Is W_REF=10u a genuine 10 um cell (audit recommends yes) or a label on a power die? Sets the kp/rd/rs targets. See _vdmos_kp_conditional.
_open_maintainer_decisions.bjt_diode_reference_cell: What physical area does AREA=1 mean? Currently undeclared and mutually inconsistent between devices (is implies 4-80 um^2, cje/cjc implies 300-900). Sets the is/cje/cjc/cjo targets.
_open_maintainer_decisions.bsim3_vs_bsim4: Fix noia/noib/noic to the BSIM3 convention, or migrate the cards to level=54? The current values are exactly right for BSIM4 and ~6.25e21x wrong for BSIM3.
_open_maintainer_decisions.nmos12_device_type: True thick-oxide 12 V gate (the wrapper says yes, so tox should be 24-30 nm) or drain-extended (xj=500nm hints yes, so tox ~11 nm)? Sets tox, rdsw, Lmin.
_open_maintainer_decisions.qualification_temperature_range: No range is stated anywhere in the model files. The audit proposes -40 to +150 degC.
